attacks.name: Shield Bounce
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.

|!wild| |!hit| |*Bounce|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make an additional |*Shield Bounce| attack. The additional attack must target another character within |!range| 3 of the original defender, may be any distance from this character, and does not have the |*Bounce| special rule.

attacks.name: Brooklyn Brawler
steps: Add dice to the attack roll equal to the defender's Size.
|!critical| |*Push|: After this attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Push it Away |!movement_small|.

|!wild| |!hit| |!block| |*Frontliner|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make an additional |*Brooklyn Brawler| attack without paying the |!power| cost. The additional attack must target a different defender and does not have the |*Frontliner| special rule.

superPowers.name: Earth‘s Mightiest Heroes (Affiliation: Avengers)
superPowers.body: Once per turn, when an allied character is attacking, during the |*Modify Dice| step, if there are one or more |!hit| results in the attack roll, it may spend 1 |!power|. If it does, it changes 1 of its results to any other result.

superPowers.name: Charge
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes a move action followed by an attack action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Perfect Block
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by an attack, it may use this superpower. Add 2 dice to this character's defense roll against that attack.
